source_title: Pilot-scale optimization of a physical-chemical biogas upgrading system based on a high alkalinity absorbent at ambient pressure and temperature
authors: Edwin G. Hoyos; Saeed Rasekhi; Rogelio Mazaeda; Raúl Muñoz
technology: carbonate absorption and air-assisted stripping with optional EDTA-Fe
operating_conditions: 20 C; initial pH 9.5; inorganic carbon 8000 mg C/L; biogas 90 L/d; air 1500 L/d; L/G 0.7; EDTA-Fe 0 mM; 7.2 L absorber and 7.2 L desorber; 21 days continuous validation
limitations: Early-stage 7 L pilot with synthetic gas; not commercial-scale energy, cost, or methane-recovery evidence.
